O3_reason_to_dismiss: The /agents/<name> route serves per-agent dashboards from a different root (agents_root, not _dashboard) and only ever appends the fixed filename dashboard.html, so it reads like a neighbouring feature the report's _dashboard traversal example does not cover.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate routes read files outside the _dashboard root: GET /agents/<name> must keep serving <agents_root>/<name>/dashboard.html, and nested static assets such as /_dashboard/data/<label>.json (written by render_global) must keep being served — a fix that contains every route under _dashboard, or that rejects any '/' in the relative path, breaks both.

O6_input_shapes: plain relative traversal in the bare-filename route (../../secret.txt)
deep multi-segment traversal to an absolute target (../../../../etc/hosts)
traversal through the /agents/ prefix, including a '..' segment as the agent name
agent names containing '/' or '\' (rejected explicitly before resolve)
absolute child paths (Path(child) ignores the root; rejected by safe_resolve_under)
symlinked path components (safe_resolve_under calls .resolve() on both sides)
benign nested sub-paths under the serving root (must still resolve and serve)

O7_producer.where: atomic_agents/dashboard/serve.py:54 (urlparse(self.path).path consumed in do_GET); the root it is checked against comes from atomic_agents/_platform.py:17-26 (ATOMIC_AGENTS_ROOT / HOME), passed in by serve() at atomic_agents/dashboard/serve.py:139

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A per-agent static sibling route (GET /agents/<name>/<rel>) that joins the raw name and relative path and hands the result straight to _serve_file.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: _serve_file already accepts an arbitrary Path and does no containment itself, and per-agent dashboards live under <agents_root>/<name>/; a maintainer adding agent-level assets would naturally reuse the same helper and forget the join is attacker-shaped.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A new ASGI route such as GET /agents/<name>/memory/<note> that builds agent_folder from request.path_params['name'] and serves or returns a vault file.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The Starlette serve module already maps path_params['name'] to root / name and each agent folder has memory/, log/ and evals/ trees, so copying the healthz/doctor body without its MUST 10 guard is a plausible addition.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A producer-side sibling: render_agent writes agents_root / data.name / dashboard.html, so an agent folder name that resolves outside the vault would both write and later be served outside the expected root.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: data.name is discovered by walking agents_root (a symlinked or crafted folder name is plausible), and the dashboard server then serves exactly that path through the unguarded join.
